newsitem.title: USA: Dlr cools heels near highs in US, holds 1.80 marks.
newsitem.headline: Dlr cools heels near highs in US, holds 1.80 marks.

text.p: *Dlr settles back from highs, still well bid near 1.80 marks, 115.50 yen. Sell interest near 116 seen capping dollar/yen.
*Traders report little fear of official mark buying, though BOI buys mark/lira for second straight day, reportedly at 971.
*MoF's Sakakibara boosted dollar/yen overnight, said yen strength expectations too high. Waigel, Germans jawbone, little impact.
